# Oil pan replacement (VG33E)

## Summary

[Partial] Drop the entire front subframe and remove all perimeter oil pan bolts. [t1889]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Drop the entire front subframe to clear the axle.
2. Remove all bolts around the perimeter of the oil pan.

_Procedure reported by [t1889]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that this procedure is specific to vehicles with 4WD where the differential interferes with access. [t1889]
